verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia tool explicitly supports spec-first API design with export to OpenAPI via UI or the `inso export spec` CLI command for CI, and it also imports OpenAPI/Swagger specs, mocks for design purposes, and linting. This directly satisfies the story's spec-first design + OpenAPI export workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the design-to-export workflow, and more detail on authoring a spec from scratch versus importing existing ones.
